input.quote: 11.2 Termination. If either party materially breaches any term or condition of this Agreement and fails to cure such breach within-thirty (30) days after receiving written notice of the breach, the nonbreaching party may terminate this Agreement on written notice at any time following the end of such-thirty (30) day period.
input.rationale: Section 11.1 commits us to an initial five-year term with automatic one-year renewals, and Section 11.2 permits termination only for uncured material breach or insolvency. There is no termination-for-convenience right for Corio (our party) anywhere in the agreement, which is a deviation under the rule for terms longer than 12 months. Commerce One likewise has no convenience right, which matches the preferred position, so the minimal fix is to insert a new Section 11.4 giving Corio a 30-day convenience right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and no early-termination penalty, while confirming that Commerce One may not walk away mid-term.

proposal.summary: Add Corio right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund and no penalty; confirm Commerce One has no convenience right during the term
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a customer right to terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, since the agreement otherwise locks us into a five-year term with exit rights only for material breach or insolvency. If helpful we can move to 60 days' notice, but we cannot accept an early-termination fee or a Commerce One convenience right during the committed term.

ops.text: 11.4 Termination for Convenience. Corio may terminate this Agreement, in whole or in part, for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Commerce One, in which case Commerce One shall refund to Corio any prepaid fees covering the period after the effective date of termination. Corio shall not be liable for any early termination fee, penalty or other charge as a result of such termination. Commerce One shall have no right to terminate this Agreement or any portion thereof for convenience during the initial five (5) year term or any renewal term.
